secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key for AI features (roleplay, flashcards, grammar exercises, feedback). Get it from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. The app has offline fallbacks without it, but AI features will be limited.

secrets.name: ELEVEN_API_KEY
secrets.description: ElevenLabs API key for high-fidelity neural voice streaming (optional). Get it from https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys.
